verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is an API product, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The evidence does not show one: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file, markdown docs, MCP server and CLI are related AI-facing features, not an OpenAPI or equivalent API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
